sources.title: Neurophysiological and Computational Principles of Cortical Rhythms in Cognition
sources.notes: 摘要。大型综述（>1200条引用）：突触抑制为振荡基础；γ/θ认知角色；长程相干；精神疾病中的振荡异常

sources.title: Rhythms for Cognition: Communication through Coherence
sources.notes: 开放全文已读。CTC框架完整内容：γ前馈选择性路由（V1-V4实验）；α/β反馈预测；θ注意采样（~7-8 Hz）；注意力调制相干增强γ峰值频率3 Hz

sources.title: An oscillatory hierarchy controlling neuronal excitability and stimulus processing in the auditory cortex
sources.authors: Lakatos P, Shah AS, Knuth KH, Ulbert I, Karmos G, Schroeder CE
sources.notes: 摘要。清醒猕猴A1记录：δ相位调制θ振幅，θ相位调制γ振幅——三层PAC层级嵌套的直接体内证据

sources.title: The functional role of cross-frequency coupling
sources.notes: 摘要+人类ECoG数据。PAC整合大尺度低频网络与局部高频计算；跨越spatiotemporal尺度的信息整合机制

sources.title: Beta-band oscillations--signalling the status quo?
sources.notes: 摘要。β振荡'状态保持'假说：维持当前状态时增强；预期变化时ERD；运动后PMBR；顶-下控制载体

sources.title: Intracellular analysis of relations between the slow (< 1 Hz) neocortical oscillation and other sleep rhythms of the electroencephalogram
sources.authors: Steriade M, Nuñez A, Amzica F
sources.notes: 摘要。慢振荡（<1Hz）在大范围丘脑损毁后仍在皮层持续产生，说明皮层独立起源；与δ/纺锤波共存；胞内直接记录

sources.title: Interneuron diversity series: inhibitory interneurons and network oscillations in vitro
sources.notes: 摘要。体外海马切片；PING/ING机制；PV中间神经元亚群功能分工；gap junction的稳定振荡作用
